svg.title: Pecos overview with a hypothetical scene
svg.desc: Pecos layout with an illustrative AGV-1 at charger C10 and trays at P3, P15, P17 and P20. Root tray R at P17 must reach bay B21, but K at P15, T20 at P20 and the dead-end charger C16 block every exit; a last step previews what has to happen: K moves aside first.
svg.metadata: ["The real Pecos geometry from the YAML: two sections, parking stalls P, customer bays B7 and B21, AGV chargers C, waypoints W and the graph edges between them. Nothing is occupied yet.", "A job asks for the car on tray R, so R is the root tray: it sits at P17 and must reach bay B21 (dashed: the requested move, not a planned route).", "R cannot leave. P17 connects only to P15, P20 and charger C16: K (empty) is at P15, T20 (with a car) is at P20, and C16 is a dead end. K and T20 are blocking trays, so one of them must move first.", "The rest of the scene: AGV-1 waits at charger C10, and tray T15 with a payload sits at P3. The approach and blocking-tray figures reuse this scene.", "What has to happen (preview): AGV-1 leaves C10 via W9 and W8 and waits at W13, next to the blockers. Before R can leave, K must be moved out of the way, for example to the free stall P19 (dashed amber); the blocking-tray figure plays that plan move by move."]
